description: HOMER is a family of commercial software from UL Solutions for modelling and optimising microgrids and hybrid power systems. The home page read on 2026-09-26 describes HOMER Pro for off-grid, remote and islanded systems and microgrids, sizing systems of solar, wind, diesel, thermal and hydro generation with storage against load profiles; HOMER Grid for behind-the-meter commercial and industrial sites and electric vehicle charging, optimising demand charges, tariffs and arbitrage; and HOMER Front for utility-scale solar, wind and battery projects with multi-year dispatch, market participation and bankability analysis. It says the HOMER platform is used by more than 250,000 system designers in over 190 countries. Coverage is any site worldwide. Access is by paid licence, with pricing pages, manuals, a knowledge base, a bibliography and advisory services linked from the page; model files are proprietary. Caveats: results are techno-economic estimates that depend on resource data, load profiles and cost inputs chosen by the user, and the product pages are promotional. Simulation uses are capacity planning and least-cost optimisation of microgrids, and resilience planning of facilities and remote communities that need power during grid outages. Related records: data-certs-microgrid-test-bed describes a microgrid test facility, and model-pypsa offers open energy system optimisation for comparison.
